title: Former Elementary School Teacher And Sister Become Billionaires After Tape Maker’s Stock Surges 787% In IPO
summary: Crown New Materials Technology, which supplies adhesive materials such as tapes to companies including BYD, Apple and Tesla, rallied as much as 787% during the firm’s first trading day in Shenzhen as local investors chased new listings.
